t: A pocket LoRa messenger with an e-paper screen, GPS, and long battery life.
steps: Buy the T-Echo from the LilyGO store or Ameridroid. Pick the radio band for your country.
Get a USB-A to USB-C cable for charging and updates.
Double-click the top-left button to open the USB drive mode.
Drag the Meshtastic .uf2 firmware file onto the drive that appears.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE with the Adafruit nRF52 board package.
Pick the Nordic nRF52840 PCA10056 board and try an example from the LilyGO T-Echo repo.
meta: Open Board. From $39.29. A few stores.
